hook: Frontier intelligence, the most advanced AI models, cost $5.14 per million tokens on October 1, 2026.

sections.voiceover: Frontier intelligence, the most advanced AI models, cost $5.14 per million tokens on October 1, 2026.

sections.voiceover: Did the tracking platform Sovyron record 1629 price changes across 333 models by October 30, 2026?

sections.voiceover: Google scheduled the Gemini 4 Argon model for release on December 1, 2026. This move shifts the input price from $2 to $4 for all developers.
